summary: BightView Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to its existing credit and receivables financing agreements, not a special situation transaction. The company extended the maturity of its seven-year Term Loans to June 17, 2033 via Amendment No. 11 to the Credit Agreement, and extended the Scheduled Termination Date of its Receivables Financing Agreement to June 12, 2029. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special event is involved. These are routine refinancing extensions that do not alter the company's equity structure or strategic direction. No deal terms are applicable.
